verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication device. Its security model is built on requiring physical user presence (a touch) for cryptographic operations, so a built-in feature for running autonomous background automations is outside its product category. The scriptable ykman CLI, the SDKs and the fleet-management REST API are programmatic surfaces a user can script against. None of them is a product-hosted automation feature, so none makes this axis apply.
